description: Submit one refresh and retain its exact-scope acknowledgement. Never interpret a receipt as completion or repeat an ambiguously accepted submission.
notes: Capture data.refreshId only when submission.correlationStatus is verified. It is parsed from an exact model/workspace Location without following that URL. The origin must match the configured endpoint, or be the public API's live-verified HTTPS regional analysis.windows.net alias. A transport trace UUID alone is NOT a refresh identity. Missing, malformed, duplicate or conflicting headers retain acknowledgement but return refreshId:null. Unreadable success bodies preserve acceptance/verified headers and do not invite resubmission. An error-bearing success returns refresh_outcome_unknown. Network/server ambiguity errors are non-retriable; investigate existing evidence. generate exposes the same receipt under framing plus top-level refreshId; framed remains legacy acknowledgement-only, and false does not prove an unknown submission failed.

query_examples.description: Extract the verified refresh UUID, or null; never substitute the newest history row when it is absent.
Keep acknowledgement, correlation and completion distinct.
